resources.string: Package names shown here were actually present in imported Health Connect records. Their presence does not prove that every metric from that app is available.
Move the selector to inspect recorded points.
Your health data, in one place
Fitness Hub works locally first. You can use it without connecting every source and change your choices later.
Your own Room database is the working archive. Health Connect is an interoperability source, not the only copy.
Health Connect reads only authorized types. Xiaomi cloud login is still disabled in this test channel; CSV and Bluetooth remain optional fallback tools.
No Fitness Hub cloud account is required. Backup/export are explicit actions and real account credentials are never requested by this onboarding.
